snippet.title: Frostpunk 2 | City Unbound - Fractured Utopias
snippet.description:
🧊Play #FracturedUtopias NOW: https://re.11bits.com/4lv
📺Watch our City Unbound playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpas7-jjCh0YxxkIYB5PPiYNRqMi80Qxj

Our first DLC to #Frostpunk 2: Fractured Utopias expands the Utopia Builder with unique paths to already existing factions, new laws, new structures, updated systems, two fresh Tales, and over 100 new narrative events - each adding new tweaks and challenges to your City’s survival ❄️

In this episode of City Unbound, we take you behind the scenes to show how your feedback shaped every part of this expansion 🖤
